Know Your Options

Cabinet enameling vs. refacing vs. replacing

Our Specialty

Cabinet Enameling

  • Your existing doors, drawers & frames — professionally refinished
  • 100% on site — nothing is ever taken off site
  • Exclusively Sherwin-Williams Gallery Series enamel
  • Smooth, sprayed, factory-style finish
  • Fastest turnaround of the three
  • Best value when your layout already works
  • Unlimited color choice, including two-tone
Middle Ground

Refacing

  • New doors over your existing boxes
  • Changes door style, keeps layout
  • Costs significantly more than enameling
  • Veneer on frames can peel over time
Full Remodel

Full Replacement

  • Everything torn out and rebuilt
  • Weeks to months without a kitchen
  • Highest cost by a wide margin
  • Makes sense only when layout changes
How It Works

The Hillcrest cabinet enameling process

Cabinets are all we do. Your doors, drawers, and frames are sprayed right in your home, on site, for a finish no brush can match. Nothing is taken off site — ever.

01

Remove & Label

Every door, drawer front, and hinge is numbered and carefully taken down — and it all stays right in your home. Nothing is taken off site.

02

Refinished On Site

Doors and drawers are degreased, sanded, primed, and sprayed inside a sealed spray booth we set up in your home — exclusively with Sherwin-Williams Gallery Series enamel.

03

Frames On Site

Your kitchen is masked and protected. Frames are prepped and enamelled in place with the same Gallery Series enamel.

04

Upgrades Installed

Soft-close hinges, new hardware, crown, and any add-ons from your quote are fitted and adjusted.

05

Reinstall & Walkthrough

Everything is rehung, aligned, and walked through with you — door by door — before we call it done.

Color Studio

Cabinet colors: don't settle for a color. Choose your color.

Tap a color and see it on a finished kitchen — these eight are the shades our clients ask for most. But they are favorites, not limits: we can enamel your cabinets in virtually any color there is, from the full Sherwin-Williams collection to a custom match pulled from something you already love. Your quote includes a color consultation, and two-tone kitchens are always an option in the calculator.

Don't see your color here? It is still yours. Bring us a paint chip, a fabric swatch, a photo — if you can point to a color, we can put it on your cabinets.

Sample Doors

See the cabinet enamel finish in person before you decide.

Photos don't do enamel justice. Request an appointment and we'll bring real sample cabinet doors — finished with the same Sherwin-Williams Gallery Series enamel we use in your kitchen — so you can hold the finished product, see the process up close, and feel the finish in your own light, in your own home. The doors are finished examples from our work, so the colors on them vary — they're there to show you the finish, not to pick a color from. Your color is chosen separately, from virtually any color there is.

  • Real sample doors, not paint chips — actual cabinet doors, prepped and sprayed exactly the way yours will be.
  • The process, door by door — see what each stage of prep and spraying produces, and how the finished enamel looks in satin and semi-gloss.
  • Smooth vs. grain-filled oak — compare finishes side by side and see what your cabinets could look like.
  • At your home, on your schedule — morning, afternoon, or evening appointments throughout our service area.
  • No obligation — the viewing is free, and your quote stays good for 30 days.

    Frequently asked questions about cabinet refinishing
    
  
    
    
    No — never. Everything we do is done on site, right in your home: doors, drawers, and frames are prepped, sprayed, and finished where they live. Nothing is taken off site at any point in the project.
    
    
    Most kitchens run 5–7 working days from start to finish. Because everything is done on site in your home — doors, drawers, and frames — your kitchen stays usable for much of the project.
    
    
    It depends on your kitchen — your piece count, the condition of your cabinets, and the upgrades you choose all change the work involved, so every Hillcrest project is quoted individually rather than from a flat rate. Build your selections in the instant quote calculator above, add at least one photo of your kitchen, and we'll email you a preliminary quote. Final pricing is set after an on-site visit, where we measure and inspect everything in person.
    
    
    Not the way we do it. We exclusively use Sherwin-Williams Gallery Series enamel, sprayed on site after degreasing, sanding, and priming — for a smooth, hard, factory-style finish that holds up to daily kitchen use.
    
    
    Yes — request a sample door viewing above and we'll bring real enameled sample doors to your home, so you can see the process and feel the finish in your own light before you decide anything.
